title: T20 Set up OpenSpec for spec-driven development

requirements.text: Install OpenSpec (`npm install -g @fission-ai/openspec`) and run `openspec init` in the repository root.
Commit the generated `openspec/` folder (`specs/` and `changes/`) and the instructions for the AI assistants the team uses.
Add a short "OpenSpec workflow" section to the README: how to create a change, how to validate it and how to archive it after merging.
Create a first example change from one of the Sprint 1 user stories (for example US001) so that the team has a reference.
